package.description: VEFlash, VEConfig and VE.Bus configure tools for configuring and updating Victron Energy products.

en-US.description: VEFlash, VEConfig and VE.Bus configure tools for configuring and updating Victron Energy products.
en-US.longDescription:
This package contains:
- VEConfigure 3
- VE.Bus Quick Configure - For installations up to 3 Multis
- VE.Bus System Configurator - For larger installations
- VEFlash - Firmware update tool to update VE.Bus products
To connect your computer to a VE.Bus product (Multis, Quattros and Inverters), you need a driver for MK2-USB (ASS030130000) / MK3-USB (ASS030140000) and an RJ45 UTP cable (ASS030064xxx and ASS030065xxx).
en-US.name: VEFlash, VEConfig and VE.Bus configure tools

zh-CN.description: VEFlash、VEConfig 和 VE.Bus 配置工具，用于配置和更新 Victron Energy 产品。
zh-CN.longDescription:
本套件包含：
- VEConfigure 3
- VE.Bus 快速配置工具 - 适用于最多 3 台 Multi 设备的安装
- VE.Bus 系统配置器 - 适用于大型安装项目
- VEFlash - VE.Bus 产品固件升级工具
连接电脑至 VE.Bus 产品（Multi、Quattro 及逆变器）需要 MK2-USB（ASS030130000）/MK3-USB（ASS030140000）驱动程序及 RJ45 UTP 网线（ASS030064xxx 和 ASS030065xxx 型号）
